about.title: About SARI Système
about.content:
Founded in 2003, SARI Système has established itself over 20 years as a major player in the distribution of medical equipment and consumables in France. Our expertise and commitment allow us to support healthcare professionals in their daily operations.

Our Mission

Our mission is to support healthcare professionals in their quest for excellence by providing innovative, reliable technological solutions tailored to their specific needs. We believe that every healthcare professional deserves the best tools to deliver quality care.

Our Values

  • Quality: All our products meet the strictest medical standards (CE, ISO 13485)
  • Responsiveness: After-sales service available 24/7 with guaranteed intervention within 48h
  • Expertise: A team of technicians and sales representatives in continuous training
  • Proximity: Personalized support from A to Z
  • Innovation: Always at the forefront of the latest medical technologies

Our History

Since our creation, we have supported over 500 healthcare facilities in their equipment needs. Our growth is based on our clients' trust and our ability to constantly innovate.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
SARI Système attaches great importance to the protection of your personal data. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information.

1. Data Collected

We collect the information you provide directly (name, email, phone, company) when you request quotes, register, or contact us.

2. Use of Data

Your data is used to:

  • Process your quote requests and orders
  • Send you our news (with your consent)
  • Improve our services
  • Comply with our legal obligations

3. Your Rights

In accordance with the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, delete, and object to the processing of your data. To exercise these rights, contact us at: dpo@sarisysteme.com

4. Security

We implement technical and organizational security measures to protect your data against any unauthorized access.

5. Cookies

Our website uses cookies to improve your experience. You can configure your browser to refuse them.

conditions.title: Terms and Conditions of Sale
conditions.content:
These General Terms and Conditions of Sale (GTC) apply to all sales of products and services made by SARI Système.

Article 1: Prices

Prices are indicated in Euros excluding VAT (HT). VAT at the current rate is added to the price. SARI Système reserves the right to modify its prices at any time.

Article 2: Orders

Any order must be confirmed in writing (email or signed purchase order). SARI Système acknowledges receipt of the order within 48 working hours.

Article 3: Delivery

Delivery times are indicated for each product. In case of delay, the client must inform us within 48h following the scheduled date.

Article 4: Warranty

All our products benefit from a manufacturer's warranty (generally 12 to 36 months). The warranty does not cover damage due to misuse.

Article 5: Payment

Payment at 30 days from the invoice date for professionals. A 2% discount is offered for cash payment.

Article 6: Returns

Unused products may be returned within 14 days. Return shipping costs are the client's responsibility unless the product is defective.
